SELECT r.*,
COALESCE(p.parentId, f.fin_sort_id) AS parentId, COALESCE(p.name, f.fin_product_name) AS name, COALESCE(p.url, f.url) AS url, COALESCE(p.material_number, f.fin_material_number) AS material_number, COALESCE(p.brand, f.price) AS brand, COALESCE(p.description, f.fin_description) AS description, COALESCE(p.number, f.fin_number) AS number,
COALESCE(p.unit, f.unit) AS unit, COALESCE(p.priceUnit, f.priceUnit) AS priceUnit
FROM material_return_receive r
LEFT JOIN product p ON r.product_id = p.id AND r.vault = p.vault
LEFT JOIN fin_product f ON r.product_id = f.id AND r.vault = f.vault
WHERE r.handle_type = 2 AND LENGTH(material_number) > 0 and receive_user=#{user}
ORDER BY CASE WHEN r.receive_user = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, r.handle_time DESC
-- 分页：第 pageNum 页，每页 pageSize 条 LIMIT #{page}, #{pageSize}

select count(*) from ( SELECT r.*,
COALESCE(p.parentId, f.fin_sort_id) AS parentId, COALESCE(p.name, f.fin_product_name) AS name, COALESCE(p.url, f.url) AS url, COALESCE(p.material_number, f.fin_material_number) AS material_number, COALESCE(p.brand, f.price) AS brand, COALESCE(p.description, f.fin_description) AS description, COALESCE(p.number, f.fin_number) AS number,
COALESCE(p.unit, f.unit) AS unit, COALESCE(p.priceUnit, f.priceUnit) AS priceUnit
FROM material_return_receive r
LEFT JOIN product p ON r.product_id = p.id AND r.vault = p.vault
LEFT JOIN fin_product f ON r.product_id = f.id AND r.vault = f.vault
WHERE r.handle_type = 2 AND LENGTH(material_number) > 0 and receive_user=#{user}
ORDER BY CASE WHEN r.receive_user = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, r.handle_time DESC) as a
